title: An empty Address 2 is hidden behind a + beside Address 1
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on the Customers page.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Customer.
  2. Hover over the + beside Address 1.
  3. Click the + beside Address 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Address 2 is not shown.
  • A + button shows beside Address 1.

Step 2:

  • The tooltip reads "Add Address 2".

Step 3:

  • An empty Address 2 field shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12304 (Story 2, Bill Invoices To in New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S2-R6: “An empty Address 2 is hidden; a + button beside Address 1 (tooltip "Add Address 2") shows it.”
  • Key Decisions: “Address 2 on demand ships with Bill To. An empty Address 2 hides behind a + in New Customer and Edit Customer.”
  • Feature Overview, Release day: “In New Customer and Edit Customer, an empty Address 2 is hidden behind a + button beside Address 1. A customer with an Address 2 opens with it showing (Story 2).”
